name: Mertyn
description: Basil's partner, whose death grieved the students and whose revenant the Devotion sent.

timeline.summary: On an expedition near Titan's Grave, the Devotion lures Basil with Mertyn's revenant; Basil disables the entity's guiding skull.
timeline.quote: Basil disabled the entity’s guiding skull with a remarkable display of magic
